blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § State and Evidence Across Boundaries
blocks.md: Before the mitigation, the context manifest selects diagnostic evidence describing the old configuration. Once the endpoint confirms that the rollback applied the new configuration, any prompt that still presents the old configuration as active state gives the model an incorrect basis for its next decision. The earlier observation remains true, but its role has changed; it no longer describes the live system and serves instead as historical evidence of the trajectory.
